bundle.shortDescription: High-resolution audiophile music player with 64-bit DSP, DSD, DLNA & AirPlay
bundle.longDescription: rooPlayer is a native Rust audiophile music player supporting local & SMB libraries, WASAPI Exclusive, 64-bit floating-point FIR upsampling, 1-bit DSD512 modulation, parametric EQ, convolution filters, DLNA/UPnP gapless streaming, AirPlay lossless ALAC streaming, and synced lyrics.
